mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webhook_endpoints ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, url, name, description, enabled_events, signing_secret, status, disabled_reason, consecutive_failures, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.URL,sensitive=true}, #{params.Name}, #{params.Description}, CAST(#{params.EnabledEvents} AS jsonb), #{params.SigningSecret,sensitive=true}, #{params.Status}, #{params.DisabledReason,sensitive=true}, #{params.ConsecutiveFailures}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM webhook_endpoints WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, uuid DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE webhook_endpoints SET url = #{params.URL,sensitive=true}, name = #{params.Name}, description = #{params.Description}, enabled_events = CAST(#{params.EnabledEvents} AS jsonb), status = #{params.Status}, disabled_reason = #{params.DisabledReason,sensitive=true}, consecutive_failures = #{params.ConsecutiveFailures}, updated_at = #{params.UpdatedAt} WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM webhook_endpoints WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'enabled' AND jsonb_exists(enabled_events, #{eventType}) ORDER BY created_at ASC, uuid ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE webhook_endpoints SET consecutive_failures = 0, disabled_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{endpointUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'enabled'

UPDATE webhook_endpoints SET consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1, status = CASE WHEN consecutive_failures + 1 >= #{params.DisableAfter} THEN 'disabled' ELSE status END, disabled_reason = CASE WHEN consecutive_failures + 1 >= #{params.DisableAfter} THEN #{params.Reason,sensitive=true} ELSE disabled_reason END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{params.EndpointUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'enabled'
